name: Megami no Shizuku ~Jonason 95~
source:
Daughter of a famous deceased thief Aya Kisaragi teams up with her father's buddy Unko. They excel in whatever job they take. This time they aim at three Nobunaga sacred treasures hidden in remote area mansion, but they get into a trap...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-february-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
已故著名盗贼如月绫的女儿与她父亲的好友云子联手。他们无论从事什么工作都表现出色。这次他们的目标是隐藏在偏远宅邸中的三件信长神器，但却陷入了陷阱……

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-february-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
